# Lightning Pay Kit

> Open-source React payment-help UI for BOLT11 Bitcoin Lightning invoices.

Lightning Pay Kit gives users a searchable, evidence-backed directory of wallets, payment apps, exchanges, and swaps that can pay a Lightning invoice. Country searches prioritize explicitly local providers and include available global providers.

## Links

- Website: https://pseudozach.github.io/lightning-pay-kit/
- Source: https://github.com/pseudozach/lightning-pay-kit
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lightning-pay-kit
- Provider data policy: https://github.com/pseudozach/lightning-pay-kit/blob/main/docs/PROVIDER_DATA.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/pseudozach/lightning-pay-kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Install

npm install lightning-pay-kit

## Minimal integration

```tsx
import { LightningPaymentHelp } from "lightning-pay-kit";
import "lightning-pay-kit/styles.css";

<LightningPaymentHelp invoice={invoice} trigger="button" />
```

## Safety model

- Handoff never proves payment; the merchant backend remains settlement authority.
- Provider actions are explicit HTTPS navigation after copying the invoice.
- No telemetry, runtime registry, project-controlled service, or automatic payment.
- Visible providers require current evidence and eligible service status.
- FixedFloat uses a disclosed default affiliate destination; hosts may replace it or disable it with `affiliateOverrides={{ fixedfloat: null }}`.

## Agent guidance

Read the repository's AGENTS.md before editing. Provider changes belong in `packages/core/src/data/providers.json`, require current first-party evidence, and must pass every documented verification gate. Pull requests to add, remove, verify, or improve the database and package are welcome.
